SETTLED TREE: packages/mpd-tui-plugin, sha256 sandwich over the whole package — start == end (e1d70e18e3e88a9b92a8f913e19ba22bfbec688e2cdc6badc4c9c1b91a0c56c7) around a 50 s settle window; all 11 hashes the writer declared at 2026-10-26T11:34:46Z verified OK, including dist/index.js 684fa6f7… Evidence: evidence/cellwork/dag-groups/2026-10-26T11-40-29Z-T6/.

D3 CLAIMS I CONFIRMED MYSELF (not from the writer's report): TUI suite 609 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail across 24 files; the new test file carries 18 arms whose names map one-for-one onto D3's sentences (one-cell+disjoint family; double-line vs rounded; port vs crossing distinct; frame spans EVERY interior row; nested frame strictly inside its parent; unplaceable group collapsed not half box; outside dependency terminates with the port glyph and an arrow above it; a leaving dependency passes THROUGH with the crossing glyph; no-groups board draws the flat picture byte for byte; innermost-frame hit identity; task outranks its frame; click names the group; a cut frame loses its OWN cells only; wholly-inside/outside untouched; narrow panel falls back to rail/list and names every group collapsed; roomy panel draws boxes with no collapse; ungrouped board keeps the pre-group fallback). ARTIFACT-LEVEL (built dist/index.js 684fa6f7…): DAG_GROUP_CHARS holds 17 entries, every one a SINGLE code point (U+2550–U+256C), DISJOINT from the 16-entry node family (no shared glyph); both DAG_CHARS_ONE_CELL and DAG_GROUP_CHARS_ONE_CELL are computed per character; `collapsedGroups` is populated from the tree's refused set AND from the flat fallback; `halfGroupCells`, `hitTestGroup`, `groupId` all present in the bundle — so the comment-only 'built artifact carries it' risk is excluded.

INTEGRATION CHECK (2), the ghost-row hazard — VERIFIED IN THE BUILT DIST: `modelRows` skips every node whose `visual === GROUP_VISUAL ('group')`, sets `depth: rankOfNode(node)` and threads `node.group` through, so a group pseudo-node can never become a task row or inflate a count; the three `modelRows` call sites all inherit that filter.

INTEGRATION CHECK (1), within-frame depth — RESIDUAL, NOT A FINDING: the built `modelRanks` still returns ONE flat Map id→`rankOfNode(node)` over EVERY model node, i.e. an interior node's IN-FRAME column is handed to any flat consumer as if it were a global rank. Inside D3 this is within the declared bound (the rail/list mode NAMES collapsed groups instead of drawing them, and the boxed ladder routes a grouped model through dag-groups' per-frame layout), so I record it as a residual for T7/T10 rather than a T3 defect — but it is a landmine for any future flat consumer of `modelRanks`.

BOUNDS: I could not probe the layout API directly — the built dist exports only `Config`, `apply`, `createPlanActions`, `name`, `resolveConfig`, `workspaceResolver` — so the frame geometry, the port/crossing choice and the collapse ladder rest on the 18 arms plus the artifact greps above, not on my own re-derivation. No PTY capture was made and none is claimed by D3 (the writer declares the same bound). The live `/state` → panel path with real groups is D2's row (T5), so T6 is fixture-scope by construction.

DECLINED TO JUDGE: (a) the README enumerates the group family as the six double-line glyphs while the module carries 17 (ports/tees/crossings are named in the following bullets) — a documentation-completeness nit for T10, not a D3 behaviour defect; (b) 'a port landing on a title drops one title character' and 'the horizontal port pair / ╪ are declared but unread' — declared bounds, accepted as such; (c) the group-id/task-id collision now reported in `collapsedGroups` instead of refusing — D3's README declares it and the model's own refusal covers the authoring path, so the renderer's tolerance is correct; (d) whether the web plane can express the same frames — D4/T8's subject.
